data.content: U.S. Men's National Soccer Team. # USMNT projected lineup vs Chile: Will Pochettino rotate his side? The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. Now, on Friday night in Paris, he sits in the France dugout and the same opponents walk out to face him. But now Kylian Mbappe is out with a knee injury, so France must find a new hero. Michael Olise, who has been at the heart of their recent goals, is the man to watch. France have won both games under Zidane by a single goal, and each time they kept a clean sheet, which shows how solid their defence has become. Olise has been involved in both goals in the Nations League for France and he also scored a goal in their last home game, so expect him to do the damage here again.
